headline: Bring Norway’s forecast into your home
intro: Met.no connects Home Assistant to the Norwegian Meteorological Institute and NRK forecast service. Set a location and elevation to create a weather entity with current conditions plus daily and hourly forecasts, without an API key.
highlights: Use the home location by default, or add the integration again with coordinates for another place
Read temperature, dew point, humidity, pressure, visibility, wind, cloud coverage, and UV index from each weather entity
Use forecast precipitation and precipitation probability; data refreshes on a randomized 55-to-65-minute interval
